Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

TECHNICAL SUPPLY CONDITIONS FOR RIVETS 



1. Scope — Covers the technical supply conditions for rivets. The standard is al&c applicable to 
such of those rivets which are not already covered under Indian Standards. 

2, General Requirements 

2.1 The rivets shall have full surfaces and edges. They shaU be free from burrs, allhough barely 
perceptible burrs which result from pressing or trimming may be left out^ provided they do not affect 
the functioning of the nvel- 

2.2 Siigli^t scaling which, however, does not peel off, as well as small scars and surface pits may be 
left out, provided they do not affect the strength or proper seating of the rivet head and shank when 
riveting. 

2.3 Unavoidable marks resulting from the shearing at the end of the shank are allowed, provided 
they do not affect the strength of the riveted joint. The rwets shall have clean sheared ends, free 
from rag or burr^ reasonably flat and square, sufficient for the purpose of drivmg the rivet ends 
satisfactorily. 

2.4 Surface prote<:tion, if required for specific applications, shaM ba specified by the purchaser. 

2.5 Surface Cracks — For snap head rivets, minor surface cracks or bursts having an opening at the 
periphery of rivet head not wider than 5 mm -i 005 times the nominal nvet diameter or 1 5 mm, 
whichever is Jess, shall not be the cause for rejection. For rivets with head of diameter > 2c/ 
(rf= shank diameter), the limit for minor surface cracks or bursts at the periphery of the nvet head 
shall be as agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 

3, Dim«n3ional Tolerances 

3.1 The tolerances on various dimensions shall be as indicated In Tables 1 to 4. The nominal 
dimensions, on which these tolerances are applicablej are given in the respective product 
standards. 

3.2 Between the measuring plane at a distance of D'5 d from the undersfde of the head and the start 
of the rounding under the rivet head, the nominal size, d, may increase up to the rivet hole diameter 
or decrease towards the shank end to a value of c/a< 

3.3 In the case of rivets with snap head and countersunk rivets, a cylindrical edge at the head with 
the values as given in Table 5 shall be allowed. 

4. Tolerances for Form and Position 

4,1 For concentricity and runout tolerance of the head with respect to the shank, the shank diameter 
shall be tho datum. The tolerances shall be as given in Table 6. 

4.1.1 The point of measurement shaU be outside the cylindrical edge» c, that is, above the edge 
in the case of snap head and below Iho edge in the case of countersunk head.

4.3 For ready referencei tha values of basic tolerances and tolerance zones aro given fn Appendix A

5- Designation — The designation of rivets shall be as given fn the respective product standards- 

6p Maferial^The material of rivets shall be as given in the respective product standards. 

7. Marking — Such marks, as specified in the product standards, shall be stamped ( raised or sunk ) 
during the process of manufacture on the heads of siU rivets with nom'mat $iz9 greater than 5 mm^ 
Rivets of size greater than 5 mm made of high tensile steel shall be marked with letter HT on thd 
rivet head. 

V. Mode of 0«livery 

8*1 Unless the purchaser has specified specific treatment at the time of enquiry or placing the order, 
the rivets shall be supplied In a well cleaned condition and suitably protected against rust, 

8.2 Rivets shall be packed in such a way tliat they are prevented from rust and mechanical damage 
during transit. All rivets Of sizes greater than 5 mm shall be packed In single gunny bags of 90 kg 
weight approximateW- 

8.2.1 The bags containing the rivets shaU bear appropriate designation as given In the product 
standards- M addition, the quantrty and the manufacturer's trade-mark and where possrb/e, a 
pictorial representation of the rivet shall be given on the bags, unless ottierwise agreed upon,

0.2 Testing for Mechanics t Properties and Matenal 

9,2.1 Shear test — Rivets shall be tested for shear by a suitable method for double shear testing 
as flhown in thd figure. If the rivets are too short for the shear test, the test shall be conducted on 
the representatrt/a sampled of the rivet bars from which the rivets are produced. 




d^ ^ J + 1 mm 

9.2.2 Hardness test — The Brinell hardness test shall be carried out in accordance with IS : 1500- 
196B ' Method for BrineU hardness test for steel [ first revis/on ) ' The ball indentation shall be 
made preferably on the zone o1 the upset point ( head ). The tensile strength calculated from the 
Brinell hardness Is only for guidance and may be considered for acceptance purposes only when it 
Is not possible to carry out the shear test for limitation of lengths In the case of non-ferrous metals, 
conversion of hardness values to tesile strength is not permissible. 

9.2.3 Head sour)dness test ^Ttie rivet shall be placed as shown in the figure- When struck 
several blows with a hammer, the head of the rivet should bend through an angle of 30° ( 90^-60°) 
without exhibiting any sign of cracking at the fillet between the head and the shank. The hardness 
of the block shall be 50 d: 2 HRC.

9.2.4 For non-destructive tests for mechanical properlies and material, the scale of sampling 
shall conform to Table 2 o1 IS : 6821-1 973 wtth acceptance numbers corresponding to AQi. of 1 percent.

criterra tor conformity shall conform to Table 1 of IS : 6821-1973. 



eXPLANATORY NOTE 



This standard lays down the general supply conditions of delivery for rivets. In addition to 
general requirements, limits of surface cracks are mclufled, Tolerai-ces for dimensions as well as 
for concentricity, runout and perpendicularity are also included based on which the limits are given 
in the product standards Shear test and head soundness test have been included in place of bend 
test and flattening test earlier included in the product standards. Sampling plans and criteria for 
conformity are also covored. 

In the preparation of the standard, assistance has been derived from the folfowing pubhcations: 

DIN 101-1977 Niete, Technische Lieferbendmgungen (Rivets, technical specifications) 
issued by DIN Dautches Institut for Normung. 

ISO/TC 2 documents N 703, N 704, N 705 and N 706 ( February 1979 ) issued by International 
Organization for Standardization ( ISO ).
